paragraphs.text: Ian was a Farrelite hailing from the border-town Montford on Dominaria .

Little is known about Ian beyond being the Farrelite champion Sianna 's friend and confidant. The two of them both harbor some views of dissension about Oliver Farrel 's motives. Ian does not appear to be at either of the disastrous encounters with Tev Loneglade and Tymolin Loneglade .
